## MSSQL Extension v0.3.0
Built against DuckDB 2.0: `v2.0-cyanoptera` at `2ec7e8401c4`, the commit in the duckdb submodule. A loadable extension loads only in the DuckDB build it was compiled for, so on a released DuckDB install it from the community repository instead: `INSTALL mssql FROM community`. DuckDB 1.5.x stays on v0.2.5.
| Linux x64 | `mssql-0.3.0-linux_amd64.duckdb_extension` |
| Linux ARM64 | `mssql-0.3.0-linux_arm64.duckdb_extension` |
| macOS ARM64 | `mssql-0.3.0-osx_arm64.duckdb_extension` |

- **多来源目录。** 可浏览 SLG、DLsite 与 VNDB，查看来源原生评分和官网资料。VNDB 封面按需读取，敏感封面可隐藏，个人封面优先。
